H_protocol: H1 literal source-compatible conduct; H2 bounded amplification; H3 local-punchline behavior unsafe to generalize; H4 actual nonliteral behavioral license. L_protocol: L0 portable proposition; L1 material phrasing/rhythm; L2 pragmatic audience, scope or register; L3 a central Japanese form needing reconstruction/annotation. A name, ordinary idiom, trope, polysemy or ruby alone is insufficient. Two narrow orthographic/ruby mechanisms receive L3; the possible weather allusion remains qualified.
